sections.hook: I didn't edit this video. Claude did all of it.
sections.stakes: And yet, your Claude is the same as mine. The difference? It only takes three settings.
elements: First setting: the app on your computer. On the website, Claude answers. On your computer, it acts. It creates your files on its own.
Second setting: connectors. In a few clicks, Claude plugs into your tools. Your email, your calendar, Notion.
And the third, this is where it gets crazy: skills. Your method, written once. It applies it every single time.
sections.recap: It acts. It plugs in. It learns. It's not a chatbot anymore. It's your team.
sections.cta: Subscribe to get the guide, then click the link in bio, and type the keyword settings.
sections.outro: And next time you see a video like this one, remember…
